name: mind-mapper
description: Show any note as a live, read-only mind map that follows you while you write: headings, lists and blocks become nodes, rendered like reading view.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts
scripts.fixtures:record: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/recordFixtures.e2e.ts
scripts.perf:e2e: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/perf/perf.e2e.ts
scripts.screenshots:e2e: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/screenshots.e2e.ts
scripts.readme:images: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/readmeImages.e2e.ts
scripts.manual:images: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/manualImages.e2e.ts
scripts.ui:images: MIND_MAPPER_DEV=1 npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/uiElementsImages.e2e.ts
scripts.listing:images: npm run build && xvfb-run -a wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts --spec ./e2e/listingImages.e2e.ts
